description: Implementation class of EmailService that provides methods to send HTML emails and manage email configurations for merchant stores, utilizing email sender components and JSON parsing.

classes.name: EmailServiceImpl
classes.description: Service implementation for email operations, including sending HTML emails and configuring email settings for merchant stores.

methods.name: sendHtmlEmail
methods.description: Sends an HTML email to a merchant store using the provided Email object, retrieving email configuration beforehand.

methods.name: getEmailConfiguration
methods.description: Retrieves and parses the email configuration for a given merchant store from stored JSON string.

methods.name: saveEmailConfiguration
methods.description: Serializes email configuration to JSON and saves it in merchant configuration storage.
